name: libreoffice-version-switcher
description: Download, install and switch between multiple LibreOffice versions side by side (CLI + web UI).

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:cli
scripts.pkg: npm run build && pkg dist/lovs.cjs --config package.json --compress GZip --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public -o release/lovs
scripts.pkg:win: npm run build && pkg dist/lovs.cjs --config package.json --compress GZip --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public -t node22-win-x64 -o release/lovs-win-x64.exe
scripts.pkg:linux: npm run build && pkg dist/lovs.cjs --config package.json --compress GZip --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public -t node22-linux-x64,node22-linux-arm64 -o release/lovs-linux
